metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for a variety of projects and tasks

plugins.name: ph-plan
plugins.description: Middle-down planning: decide and write down what gets built. Thirteen skills and six principles for an interactive session — intake routing, relentless grilling, domain modeling, frontier scouting, triage, specs and tickets. Every session ends in a written artifact carrying which of the four dimensions it closed. Requires ph-lib.

plugins.name: ph-build
plugins.description: Unattended implementation: build what was decided, at a cost that tracks what is still unknown. Thirty-three skills, twenty-three principles, nineteen playbooks and three agents, forked from pstack. Reads the rigor signal a spec carries, gates expensive multi-agent work behind one-way doors, and caps every fan-out. Requires ph-lib.

plugins.name: ph-lib
plugins.description: Shared library for the photon plugins: four primitives that ph-plan and ph-build reference and require (codebase-design, technical-writing, unslop, writing-for-agents), plus nine operator tools you invoke directly (automate-me, bro, caveman, handoff, recall, reflect, teach, wait-what, what-did-i-get-done). Not a hat — nobody installs this because of the work they are doing.

plugins.name: ph-lead
plugins.description: Engineering leadership and people management: 1:1s and skip-levels, difficult conversations, delegation, managing up, cross-functional collaboration, timelines and status, meetings and offsites, decision processes, OKRs, org design and transformation, team culture and rituals, post-mortems, and systems thinking. Twenty-four skills with a router.

plugins.name: ph-php
plugins.description: Comprehensive PHP development covering WordPress, Laravel, Sage/Roots, WooCommerce, as well as CodeIgniter 3 legacy maintenance

plugins.name: technical-director
plugins.description: Fifty-two skills and two autonomous agents for technical direction and engineering leadership: an engineering workflow (diagnosis, domain modeling, specs, issue triage, TDD, codebase design and architecture, prototyping, implementation, human-in-the-loop setup wizards, repo-tooling guardrails), a leadership category (1:1s, difficult conversations, delegation, managing up, cross-functional collaboration, timelines, meetings, decisions, and org design), productivity tools (grilling, handoffs, teaching, questionnaires, and writing for agents), plus ticket-to-implementation and PR-review agents for agent-thread harnesses

plugins.name: developer-workflow
plugins.description: Developer workflow skills for daily development tasks including CLAUDE.md authoring, conventional/gitmoji commit helpers, and git worktree management with sibling-placement rules

plugins.name: ph-npo
plugins.description: Seven skills for nonprofit operations: a foundational organization profile builder that personalizes the rest, plus grant writing, budget creation, donor thank-you communications, social media content, volunteer scheduling, and Givebutter integration.

plugins.name: ph-pm
plugins.description: Atlassian and scrum operations: Jira, Confluence, Atlassian administration and templates, sprint analytics, senior-PM portfolio and risk management, meeting-transcript analysis, and internal team communications. Eight skills; bundles the Atlassian Remote MCP server.
